# Lincoln University

> > Lincoln University is the nation's first degree-granting HBCU, founded in 1854, offering comprehensive academic and student support services.

Lincoln University, located in Pennsylvania, is a historically Black university with a rich legacy of educating leaders and changemakers. The institution provides extensive resources across admissions, academics, student life, and campus services to support student success and institutional advancement.

## Key Topics

- HBCU
- First degree-granting historically Black university
- Founded 1854
- Admissions
- Student success
- Faculty resources
- Campus life
- Academic support
- Student services
- Research
- Liberal arts

- Pennsylvania
- Institutional mission

## Admissions & Getting Started

- [Admissions](https://www.lincoln.edu/admissions/index.html): Admissions information for undergraduate, international, and veteran students
- [About Lincoln University](https://www.lincoln.edu/about/index.html): About Lincoln University: history, mission, values, and institutional overview
- [History](https://www.lincoln.edu/about/history.html): Lincoln University founding in 1854 as Ashmun Institute, first HBCU
- [Mission](https://www.lincoln.edu/about/mission.html): Lincoln University mission statement, vision, and institutional values

## Student Life & Academic Support

- [Student Life](https://www.lincoln.edu/student-life/index.html): Student life resources, activities, clubs, Greek life, and academic support
- [Student Success](https://www.lincoln.edu/student-success/index.html): Student success programs including academic support and wellness services
- [Langston Hughes Memorial Library](https://www.lincoln.edu/langston-hughes-memorial-library/index.html): Library services, research assistance, and academic resources for students

## Faculty & Staff Resources

- [Faculty and Staff](https://www.lincoln.edu/faculty-and-staff/index.html): Faculty and staff resources including research, planning, and benefits
- [Faculty & Staff Directory](https://www.lincoln.edu/directory/index.html): Faculty and staff directory with contact information and department search
- [Office of Faculty Affairs](https://www.lincoln.edu/academics/academic-affairs/office-faculty-affairs/index.html): Faculty affairs office guidelines for recruitment, retention, and development

## Campus Services & Support

- [Parents](https://www.lincoln.edu/parents/index.html): Parent resources for financial aid, campus safety, and student notifications
- [Public Safety](https://www.lincoln.edu/public-safety/index.html): Public safety department contact, campus security, and emergency notifications
- [Information Technology](https://www.lincoln.edu/about/information-technology/index.html): IT support, software access, help desk, and technology services

## News & Community

- [Lincoln News](https://www.lincoln.edu/news/index.html): Campus news and recent articles including awards and international relations

## Optional

- [Campus Store](https://www.lincoln.edu/campus-store/index.html): Campus store merchandise, apparel, and textbook ordering services
